BimDataFrames

A classified run from 05_cpt_classification.py as two bimpolars BimDataFrames, in the same site CRS as the GeoTOP voxels of 01_get_data.py, written as GeoParquet to data/bimdataframes/ for sync_r2.py:
  • The interpreted CPTs: each CPT's samples of the run's height, classified with robertson as in 05. Consecutive samples of the same soil behavior type (SBTn) merge into one cylinder per layer, wider than the cone so that it remains visible.
  • The SBTn volumes: all cells with the same most likely SBTn merge into one volume, the outer surface of those cells. A volume can consist of several separate parts. The volumes leave out a pit, where the CPTs and part of the foundations stand free.
Each row carries the summary statistics of what it merges, in the property set CPT or SBTn volume.
